title: Pure-tensor signed Leibniz identity for three external Cech bidegrees
statement: Let k be a field, f:X→Spec k and g:Y→Spec k, U:I→Opens(X) and V:J→Opens(Y) arbitrary families, and F,G modules. Use the scalar Cech complexes A=C_U(F), B=C_V(G), C=C_W(pr₁*F tensor pr₂*G) of [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models], with W_(i,j)=pr₁⁻¹U_i intersect pr₂⁻¹V_j. Fix p,q in ℕ and three k-linear maps h:A^p tensor_k B^q→C^(p+q), h₁:A^(p+1) tensor_k B^q→C^(p+1+q), h₂:A^p tensor_k B^(q+1)→C^(p+q+1). Suppose each has its prescribed front/back coordinates [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-bidegree]. For a∈A^p and b∈B^q, d_C(h(a tensor b))=transport(h₁(d_A(a) tensor b))+(-1)^p transport(h₂(a tensor d_B(b))), where the transports identify (p+1)+q and p+(q+1) with (p+q)+1. No map in any other bidegree, total complex, covering or finiteness hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Apply target Cech coordinate extensionality. The three prescribed front/back formulas express h, h₁ and h₂ on pure tensors by pulled section coordinates. Naturality of the normalized pullback adjunction units, presheaf composition and tensor-section restriction identify the successive restrictions when the scalar Cech differentials are expanded. This is the external version of the face calculation underlying cechCupCochain_leibniz; no total coproduct is involved.

Expand the alternating face sums. The front terms indexed 0,...,p match target faces 0,...,p. The final front term and first back term have identical restricted sections and coefficients (-1)^(p+1) and (-1)^p, hence cancel. The remaining back terms r=1,...,q+1 match target faces p+r with coefficient (-1)^(p+r). Splitting the finite target sum at p+1 proves the coordinate identity. Degree transports identify equal tuple lengths, so coordinate extensionality gives the statement. For p=0 or q=0 the cancellation still holds, in characteristic two the paired terms sum to zero, and empty index families and zero modules give vacuous or zero coordinate identities.

    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    (p q : ℕ)
    (h : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q))
    (h₁ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X (p + 1))).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X ((p + 1) + q))
    (h₂ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X (q + 1)) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + (q + 1)))
    (hh : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q h)
    (hh₁ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G (p + 1) q h₁)
    (hh₂ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p (q + 1) h₂)
    (a : ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)
    (b : ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) :
    ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).d
        (p + q) (p + q + 1) (h (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) =
      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n)
        (Nat.add_right_comm p 1 q))) 
          (h₁ (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).d p (p + 1) a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) +
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ p • (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n)
        (Nat.add_assoc p q 1).symm))
          (h₂ (a ⊗ₜ[k] ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).d q (q + 1) b))
